scope.covered_artifacts: The 100 m annual Dynamic World mode labels, annual VIIRS mean-radiance grids, and static SRTM elevation and slope grids used by OBSERVED-O1, plus derived tabular benchmark bundles.
scope.not_covered: Google Earth Engine account credentials, Earth Engine service quota, third-party branding, or any later-added source layer.
scope.derivation: All covered rasters are clipped, resampled and/or temporally reduced derivatives. Any public release must retain the source notices below and state that these are derived benchmark artifacts rather than official source products.

sources.publisher: Google, National Geographic Society, and World Resources Institute
sources.applies_to: Annual mode-composited Dynamic World class rasters for 2017-2023; 2017-2020 are inputs and 2021-2023 are labels.
release_obligations: License derived data under terms compatible with CC BY 4.0.
Credit the Dynamic World dataset as produced by Google in partnership with National Geographic Society and World Resources Institute.
State that the benchmark uses clipped, resampled annual mode composites rather than the native Dynamic World product.
Retain the applicable Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice.

sources.publisher: Earth Observation Group, Payne Institute for Public Policy, Colorado School of Mines
sources.applies_to: Annual mean-radiance derivatives from 12 monthly VIIRS DNB images for 2016-2023; only 2016-2020 are benchmark inputs.
evidence_markers: Earth Observation Group, Payne Institute for Public Policy, Colorado School of Mines
release_obligations: Cite the VIIRS DNB source and its Earth Observation Group provider for provenance.
State that the release contains annual means derived from the monthly collection and is not an official monthly product.

sources.publisher: NASA JPL via NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center
sources.applies_to: Static SRTM elevation and slope derivatives used by all OBSERVED-O1 regions.
evidence_markers: This dataset is openly shared, without restriction
NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second
release_obligations: Cite NASA JPL (2013), NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second, DOI 10.5067/MEASURES/SRTM/SRTMGL1.003.
State that slope is a benchmark-derived quantity and elevation is a clipped and resampled derivative.

release_gate.remaining_blocker: An external hidden-label boundary has not been established. This review does not authorize a public benchmark release before that independent gate passes.

claim_boundary: This is a provenance and source-terms audit, not legal advice. It covers only the named source products and the stated derived artifacts.
